title: Chapter 473: Expedition
content:
Chapter 473: Expedition

Wang Shuo was sad for a long time because of this.

He even stopped sending generals to the Tomb of the King for a while.

But the remaining people were unwilling to give up and asked Wang Shuo to enter the Tomb of the King several times. Wang Shuo carefully examined the strength of the candidates and allowed them to enter.

Wang Shuo probably knew that if he was not strong enough, it would be difficult to survive in the Tomb of the King.

In particular, the final climb to Youquan Mountain was extremely dangerous.

A few months passed.

The Vana Empire has newly promoted several strongest kings.

Including Zhao Bangde, Zhu Dongheng, Ayub, Gong Zheng, Li Jianguo, Ye Tianba, Li Weiguo, Gong Kai, Gu Liji, and Xie Xiaofeng, a total of ten people.

Including Wang Shuo and his three pets.

The Vana Empire already has fourteen strongest kings, and the number of Roland Empire and Mali Dynasty combined is less than half of that of the Vana Empire.

The time to send troops to the two countries is gradually ripe.

As for weapons and supplies, the Vana Empire has also mastered advanced catapult technology, which is the siege technology commonly used by the Shenwu Empire.

Whether it is field warfare or siege warfare, the technology and command are already available. As long as Wang Shuo gives an order, millions of troops can go to the front line to expand the territory for the empire.

Of course, the empire is civilized on the surface, and all the wars it launches are just.

For this war, Wang Shuo also has to find a high-sounding excuse.

This excuse is the second prince.

Wang Shuo immediately announced that he supported the second prince and the seventh prince's brother usurped the throne, which was a great treason.

He called on all the heroes in the world to attack him together.

Wang Shuo knew that once he did this, he would inevitably stand on the opposite side of countless great empires.

But he had fully analyzed the current situation on the Vlandia continent.

He was on the edge of the continent, and the empire that had the ability to defeat him was very far away from him.

And the large empires nearby were not his opponents at all.

Wang Shuo has a natural geographical advantage. The number of masters in the empire has approached the level of the first-level empire. There are many talents and people.

The remaining is the right time. Now the world is in chaos, the Shenwu Empire is in name only, and the first-level empires are hindering each other. It is a good time for Wang Shuo to expand his territory.

At Wang Shuo's command, the army of the Wana Empire went to the battlefield.

This time, the army was divided into two groups. One group was led by Ayub to attack the Mali Dynasty.

And Wang Shuo personally led one group to attack the Roland Empire.

The queen of the Roland Empire, Violet, was horrified when she heard the news.

As early as the rise of the Wana Empire, she was a little worried, and then she found the Mali Dynasty in the northeast of the Wana Empire to form an alliance.

It's not that he doesn't want to form an alliance with a higher-level dynasty, but others look down on her. At the same time, she is also worried that forming an alliance with a stronger dynasty will easily lead to wolves.

But she never dreamed that the Wana Empire would develop so rapidly.

In just a few years, it has the strength to crush her.

Looking back now, the war with the Wagarian Empire was simply ridiculous.

The main generals who conquered the Roland Empire were Gong Zheng and Ye Tianba.

Those who conquered the Mali Dynasty included Ayub, Zhao Bangde, Li Jianguo, Xie Xiaofeng and others.

Only the prime minister stayed in the capital, and Wang Shuo only brought two people, and the rest followed Ayub to the war.

After a month of fierce fighting, Wang Shuo had already reached the head of the Roland Empire.

In previous wars, Wang Shuo almost always fought defensive battles.

The first large-scale siege made Wang Shuo a little excited.
